description.summary: applets from other programs, embedded in a shell's bars

protocol.description:
A desktop shell draws its bars as layer surfaces. Third-party applets are separate programs with their own surfaces. This protocol lets the compositor place an applet's surface inside a bar, at a slot the shell has reserved, so that the applet looks like part of the bar (behind the same glass), receives pointer and keyboard input directly, and opens its own popups, without the shell having to act as a compositor for it.
The flow: - The shell creates a slot on one of its bar surfaces with rikkiti_applet_host_v1 and receives a token. - It starts the applet with that token (by convention in the RIKKITI_APPLET_TOKEN environment variable). - The applet creates a wl_surface, asks rikkiti_applet_manager_v1 for an applet object with the token, and draws at the size it is configured to. It may say what size it would like; the shell decides. - The compositor shows the applet's surface at the slot, clipped to it. - When the applet's surface or connection goes away, the shell is told and receives a new token; the slot stays empty until an applet binds again. An applet never breaks a bar.
Its first user is a desktop shell that hosts third-party panel applets. This is a draft of version 1 (second revision, after a review from the Baldr toolkit's side): it may change before it is frozen.

interface.name: rikkiti_applet_host_v1

description.summary: for the shell: reserve slots for applets in its bars

interface.description: A global for the shell. A client may create slots only on its own layer surfaces.

entry.name: invalid_host
entry.summary: the host surface isn't a layer surface of this client

entry.name: invalid_geometry
entry.summary: the slot has no area, or a negative size

entry.name: invalid_edge
entry.summary: the edge isn't one of the edge values

enum.name: edge

description.summary: the screen edge the bar is on

enum.description: Tells an applet which way its bar runs (top and bottom bars are horizontal, left and right ones vertical) and which way its popups should open.

description.summary: destroy the host object

request.name: create_slot

description.summary: reserve a slot in a bar

request.description: Reserves a rectangle of the host surface, in its surface-local coordinates, for one applet. A token event follows at once.

arg.name: host
arg.summary: one of this client's layer surfaces

arg.name: edge
arg.summary: the edge the bar is on

interface.name: rikkiti_applet_slot_v1

description.summary: a place in a bar for one applet

interface.description: The shell's handle on one slot. At most one applet is bound to a slot at a time.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: remove the slot

request.description: The applet bound to it, if any, receives rikkiti_applet_v1.closed and is no longer shown. The host surface being destroyed has the same effect on its slots.

request.name: set_geometry

description.summary: move or resize the slot

request.description: Takes effect with the host surface's next commit, so the bar and the applet move together. A bound applet is configured to a new size or edge, and its reactive popups are placed again (see rikkiti_applet_v1.get_popup). An edge that isn't one of the edge values leaves the edge as it was.

event.name: token

description.summary: the token an applet binds with

event.description: Sent when the slot is created, and again after an applet detaches. A token is used once and belongs to this slot only. It is an opaque string; give it to the applet to start, and nothing else.

event.name: attached

description.summary: an applet has bound to the slot

event.description: Sent when an applet binds the slot's token.

arg.name: pid
arg.summary: the applet's process id, or 0 when unknown

event.name: detached

description.summary: the applet has gone

event.description: The applet's surface, its applet object or its connection went away. The slot is empty and shows nothing; a token event with a new token follows.

event.name: size_hint

description.summary: the size the applet would like

event.description: Relays rikkiti_applet_v1.set_size_hint: the applet's minimum and preferred length along the bar (its width in a top or bottom bar, its height in a left or right one), in surface-local units; 0 means no preference. The shell may give it any size, with set_geometry.

description.summary: for applets: become part of a bar

entry.name: role
entry.summary: the surface already has another role

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the surface already has an applet object

request.name: destroy

description.summary: destroy the manager

request.description: Existing applet objects are not affected.

request.name: get_applet

description.summary: bind a surface to a slot

request.description: Gives the surface the applet role. A token that is unknown, used already or belongs to a slot that has gone is not an error: the applet object receives closed at once, so a restarted applet holding a stale token exits cleanly.

interface.name: rikkiti_applet_v1

description.summary: an applet surface in a bar

interface.description: An applet is configured to its slot's size and its bar's edge. It must acknowledge the configure and commit a buffer of that size (in surface-local units); anything beyond the slot is clipped. It is shown once it has committed a buffer after its first acknowledged configure. It receives pointer input where it is shown, and keyboard focus when clicked (see set_keyboard_interactivity). Its surface's scale and output follow the bar's.

entry.name: invalid_popup
entry.summary: the popup already has a parent, or isn't an xdg_popup with a NULL parent

entry.name: invalid_keyboard_interactivity
entry.summary: the value isn't one of the keyboard_interactivity values

entry.name: none
entry.summary: the applet never takes keyboard focus

entry.name: on_demand
entry.summary: the applet takes keyboard focus when clicked

request.name: destroy

description.summary: leave the bar

request.description: The surface is no longer shown and the slot is told the applet detached.

request.name: ack_configure

description.summary: acknowledge a configure

request.description: The next commit applies the configure with this serial.

request.name: set_size_hint

description.summary: say what length along the bar the applet would like

request.description: The minimum and preferred length along the bar (width in a top or bottom bar, height in a left or right one), 0 for no preference. The compositor passes it to the shell (rikkiti_applet_slot_v1.size_hint), which decides; a new size arrives as a configure.

request.name: set_keyboard_interactivity

description.summary: whether the applet takes keyboard focus

request.description: on_demand (the default): a click on the applet gives it keyboard focus, as with a layer surface's on_demand, for applets with text fields or shortcuts. none: it never takes focus; switching to none while it has focus (on Escape, say) returns focus to the window on top. A popup that grabs takes keyboard focus as any xdg_popup does, whichever the setting.

request.name: get_popup

description.summary: make an xdg_popup a child of the applet

request.description: As zwlr_layer_surface_v1.get_popup: the popup is created with a NULL parent through xdg_surface.get_popup, then made the applet's child here, before its first commit. Its positioner's anchor rectangle is relative to the applet surface, and it is kept on the bar's output. A grab needs the serial of input the applet received; a press on anything outside the applet's popups, the bar around it included, dismisses them. When the slot moves, a popup whose positioner is reactive is placed again and receives a new configure.

description.summary: the size to draw at, and the bar's edge

event.name: closed

description.summary: the applet isn't shown and won't be

event.description: The slot was removed, or the token wasn't valid. The client should destroy the object (and usually exit); nothing it commits is shown.
